shell.update.title: Sabuntawa
shell.update.failed: Ba a iya dubawa ba. Sake gwadawa daga baya.
shell.update.installNote: "Sabunta" yana sauke sabuwar siga, ya tabbatar cewa da gaske daga gare mu take, sannan ya saka ta a kan wannan. Ana riƙe saitunanka kuma shirin zai sake farawa. Ba a sauke komai har sai ka zaɓa.
shell.update.installFailed: Ba a iya saka sabuntawar daga nan ba. Samo sabuwar siga daga shafin saukewa sannan ka saka ta a kan wannan; za a riƙe saitunanka.
shell.update.automatic: Duba sabuntawa da labarai lokacin da shirin ya fara
shell.update.automaticNote: Yana karanta ƙananan fayiloli biyu daga syntelab.com. Ba a aika komai game da kai ko kwamfutarka.
shell.help.feedbackHint: Faɗa mana abin da kake buƙata: nemi sabuwar manhaja, sabon fasali ko canji, ko kai rahoton matsalar da ka gamu da ita. Ana karanta kowane saƙo. Shafin ra'ayi yana buɗewa a burauzarka; ba a aika komai daga shirin kansa ba.
shell.donate.hint: Kana son abin da kake gani? Taimaka mana mu gina wannan manhaja ta kyauta kuma mu ci gaba da inganta ta. Tallafinka yana bunƙasa dukkan tsarin Syntelab Creative, har da kai ma.
shell.start.resetHint: Sake nuna dukkan manhajoji a matsayin katuna, a jerinsu na asali.
shell.layout.globalNote: Tsarin kowace manhaja. Manhaja na iya samun tsarinta na kanta, wanda aka zaɓa a sashinta na Saituna.
shell.layout.overrides: Wannan manhaja tana da tsarinta na kanta. Yana maye gurbin tsarin gaba ɗaya kuma yana shafar wannan manhaja kawai.
shell.layout.followsGlobal: Wannan manhaja tana bin tsarin gaba ɗaya. Zaɓar ɗaya a nan zai maye gurbinsa, ga wannan manhaja kawai.
shell.layout.useGlobal: Yi amfani da tsarin gaba ɗaya
shell.ribbon.mode.fullHint: Manyan maɓallai tare da sunayensu, a cikin rukunoni masu suna.
shell.ribbon.mode.compactHint: Alamomi kawai; sunan umarni yana bayyana idan alamar mouse ta tsaya a kansa.
shell.ribbon.mode.hover: Nuna idan alamar mouse tana kai
shell.ribbon.mode.hoverHint: Tab kawai ake barin su. Umarnin tab suna buɗewa a saman shafin yayin da alamar mouse take kan sunansa.
shell.command.notYet: {hint} Ba ya cikin wannan sigar tukuna.
shell.tabs.startAlways: Riƙe tab ɗin Farko a cikin sauran tab
shell.tabs.startAlwaysNote: A kashe: tab ɗin Farko yana bayyana ne kawai lokacin da Farko kansa yake gaba. Idan wata manhaja tana buɗe, gidan da ke saman sandar gefe yana dawo da shi.
shell.explorerMenu.title: Windows Explorer
shell.explorerMenu.show: Nuna Syntelab Creative a menu na danna-dama na fayiloli da folda
shell.explorerMenu.note: Yana ƙara waɗannan abubuwa don mai amfaninka kaɗai, ba tare da haƙƙin mai gudanarwa ba: {entries}. A Windows 11 suna ƙarƙashin "Show more options". Kashe wannan kafin ka cire shirin.
shell.explorerMenu.development: Wannan sigar haɓakawa ce: ba ta ƙara abubuwan, domin za su buɗe wannan sigar. Kunna wannan a cikin shirin da aka shigar.
shell.explorerMenu.failed: Ba a iya canza menu ɗin ba.
shell.explorerMenu.incomplete: Manhajojin sun sami sababbin abubuwa tun lokacin da aka ƙara waɗannan: {entries}.
shell.help.openHint: Littafin jagorar shirin da na manhajojinsa, a cikin tab nasa don karantawa kusa da aikinka: jerin abubuwan ciki, bincike, da kowane umarni na wannan tab tare da abin da yake yi. Wani ɓangare ne na shirin: ba a ɗauko komai daga intanet ba.
shell.help.title: Taimako
shell.help.nothingFound: Ba a sami komai ba. Gwada ƙananan kalmomi ko wasu kalmomi.
shell.help.commands: Umarnin tab ɗin da ka fito daga ciki
shell.help.commandsNote: Kowane umarni na wannan menu, kamar yadda yake a tab ɗin da aka buɗe Taimako daga ciki, tare da maɓallansa da abin da yake yi.
shell.tooltips.show: Abin da maɓalli yake yi, ana faɗa idan alamar mouse tana kansa
shell.shortcuts.note: Waɗannan maɓallai suna aiki a kowace manhaja. Danna maɓallan wani umarni, sannan ka danna sababbin; Escape yana barin su yadda suke, Backspace yana cire su. Maɓallan umarnin manhaja suna a sashinta na Saituna.
shell.help.aboutHint: Menene shirin da kowace manhaja, wace siga ce wannan, da me aka gina su, abin da ba za su iya yi ba tukuna, abin da ake aiki a kai da yadda za ka taimaka.
shell.tooltips.instantNote: Bayanin gaggawa yana bayyana da zarar alamar mouse ta kasance kan wani abin sarrafawa. Ko'ina a cikin shirin.
shell.tooltips.delayedNote: Bayanin gaggawa yana bayyana bayan alamar mouse ta tsaya kan wani abin sarrafawa na daƙiƙa 2. Ko'ina a cikin shirin.
shell.tooltips.offNote: Babu bayanin gaggawa a ko'ina a cikin shirin. Har yanzu za a iya karanta abin da umarni yake yi a Taimako, ƙarƙashin umarnin wani tab.
